Container.Name: Ledger
Container.Overview: Household budget: zero-based envelope budgeting, debt snowball (smallest balance first), bills & paydays calendar with cash-flow forecast, quick-add from your phone (home-screen app, Siri, or the Claude app), CSV bank import, reports and an ICS feed of bills. Single container, all data in one SQLite file under /data.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port on your Unraid server for the web UI (8091 sits next to Nexus on 8090).

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database (ledger.db) and nightly backups (backups/). Include this folder in your appdata backups.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Optional. The https address you reach Ledger at from outside, e.g. https://ledger.example.com. Needed for the Claude app connector and for links in notifications.

Config.Name: Bank sync interval (hours)
Config.Description: How often to pull new bank transactions from SimpleFIN Bridge (set up in Ledger → Settings → Bank sync).

Config.Name: Backups to keep
Config.Description: Nightly database snapshots kept in /data/backups. 0 disables.

Config.Name: Backup: passphrase
Config.Description: Encrypts off-server backups (required for cloud). Store it safely – backups can't be restored without it.

Config.Name: Backup: S3 bucket
Config.Description: Bucket name (can be the same bucket as Nexus – Ledger uses the ledger/ prefix)

Config.Name: Backup: copy to folder
Config.Description: Optional: a folder on another disk/share for encrypted backup copies. Also set BACKUP_COPY_DIR=/backup-copy below.

Config.Name: Backup: copy dir (inside container)
Config.Description: Set to /backup-copy if you mapped the folder above

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP host
Config.Description: Email notifications: your mail provider's SMTP server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com

Config.Name: Notify: SMTP password
Config.Description: For Gmail/iCloud use an app password
